title: handleSave template-fields loop is sequential N+1 â€” large templates take N Ã— round-trip
detail: Lines 658-680: `for (var i = 0; i < localFields.length; i++) { await apiPostReturnId/apiPatch(...) }`. One HTTP round-trip per field. A template with 40 fields = 40 sequential POST/PATCHes. At ~200ms per round-trip on Power Pages that's 8 seconds of blocking UI for a save. Worse, lines 683-692 then do ANOTHER sequential loop for audit log writes. Combined: 2N sequential calls.
evidence: TemplateDetail.jsx:658-680 field save loop, 683-692 audit loop.
recommendedFix: Parallelize both loops with Promise.all. Risk: race condition on writeAuditLog ordering â€” acceptable since order is preserved in dcfg_performed_at. Field save loop: `await Promise.all(localFields.map(async (f, i) => { const body = ...; if (f.dcfg_template_fieldid) await apiPatch(...); else { body['dcfg_template_id@odata.bind'] = ...; await apiPostReturnId(...); } }));`. Same treatment for audit log loop.

title: Composite `contract_value_written` references non-existent `dcfg_contract_value` and `dcfg_contract_value_written`
detail: Lines 522-528: `contract_value_written` composite defines parts with paths `dcfg_contract_value_written` and `dcfg_contract_value`. Per engineering journal Section 9, `dcfg_contract_value` does not exist; it should be `dcfg_contract_fee`. `dcfg_contract_value_written` similarly likely doesn't exist (no grep hits across /src). Same bug as CR-0296 but in the getCompositeParts function used by the detection code path â€” auto-detected composites pick the wrong paths.
recommendedFix: Change line 526 path to `dcfg_contract_fee`. For line 525, either create `dcfg_contract_fee_written` calculated field in Dataverse or remove the written form from the composite (use only the numeric).
